fieldDescription: TRUE: Reward hullmods are visible in the refit picker and may be installed once their Hall of Triumph requirements are met. FALSE: Reward hullmods are hidden from the refit picker and cannot be newly installed. Hall of Triumph hullmods already fitted to ships remain installed and continue applying their full effects.

TRUE: When Nexerelin and MagicLib are enabled, incomplete Hall achievements are shown and their progress is checked. FALSE: Incomplete Hall achievements are hidden and make no progress; completed achievements remain visible. This setting has no effect when either optional mod is absent.

WARNING: This option is unstable. Tours may cause the star-system background texture to disappear, and some ship weapons or decorative details may be missing. Disabled by default. TRUE: Show the Ship Gallery option at player colonies with a functional Hall of Triumph. FALSE: Hide the option and prevent opening the Gallery.
